title: The actions menu offers Deactivate parts between Cycle count and Export
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919). The Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete'.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-MENU-01) is active at {Location-A}.
  • Inventory part {Part-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-MENU-02) is inactive at {Location-A}.
custom_steps:
1. In the top bar click Parts, then click Inventory in the left menu.
  2. Click the ⋮ actions menu button in the toolbar, to the left of New Inventory Part.
  3. Press Escape to close the menu.
  4. Click the Inactive tab.
  5. Click the ⋮ actions menu button.
  6. Press Escape to close the menu.
  7. Click the Active tab.
  8. Click the ⋮ actions menu button.
  9. Click Deactivate parts.
  10. Click the X at the right end of the dark bar.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 2: The menu lists, from top to bottom, "Cycle count", "Deactivate parts" and "Export" (3 entries). "Activate parts" is not in it.
  • Step 5: On the Inactive tab the menu lists "Cycle count", "Activate parts" and "Export". "Deactivate parts" is not in it.
  • Step 9: Bulk mode turns on: a dark bar appears under the tabs and a checkbox column appears in the list.
  • Step 10: Bulk mode ends, and the bar and the checkboxes disappear.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10815 (Story 2, Deactivate Parts in Bulk); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S2-R1, S2-R2, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 4.1 (The actions menu), board 4.6 (Inactive tab, Activate parts), 13 Oct copy. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S2-R1: “Bulk deactivation is a mode. The user turns it on from the Inventory actions menu, the three-dot button in the toolbar that holds Cycle count and Export.”
  • S2-R2: “The menu entry reads "Deactivate parts" while the Active tab shows and "Activate parts" while the Inactive tab shows. Only one of the two shows at a time. It sits between Cycle count and Export.”
  • S3-R1: “Reactivation uses the same mode as Story 2. On the Inactive tab the actions menu entry reads "Activate parts", and turning it on shows the same checkbox column and the same bulk bar.”
